Hello Freya,

Re: Flat 23, 143 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ2 6ZZ – Ref R/PM046-1

Your landlord has agreed for a contractor to come and look at the bedroom window with the rusted hinge. We are now arranging a suitable contractor, and either we or the contractor will contact you to agree a visit time. We aim to update you within 2 working days.

In the meantime, please avoid forcing the window, and if it won't close securely, keep the room secure as best you can and let us know straight away if the window becomes stuck open or the hinge gives way.

Could you reply with any days/times that are not convenient for access, so we can pass this on?

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
